items.title: Warren Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 23, 1995
items.q: I walked into the club, he bought me a drink, we went up to play the last set... he points at me to take the first solo... Roy calls a tune, we play the first chorus

ctx.x: The club scene, yeah. I mean I worked at Condon’s for four years, alongside Vic Dickinson and two or three doors down the street was Jimmy Ryan’s and Roy Eldridge was there every night. So I was very fortunate to catch that. And that didn’t happen almost anywhere else in the world, you know.
A lot of the fellows we’ve been talking to who play swing or classic jazz or whatever we want to call it —
